player_prompt.intro:
Jani Blackjack utji dealer jach'awinakaraki.
Jani t'akhi punku 21 sata sartasi, manq'aspa jani.
Janiraki, usari '[Hit]' utji aka kamana, '[Stand]' utji jani t'akhi.
J/Q/K = 10 punku; A = 11 utji 1, janiraki sataki.
